services.name: San Juan Mini Boat Tour
services.desc: The San Juan Mini Boat Tour is one of the most exciting and interactive water adventures in Puerto Rico. Instead of sitting back on a crowded cruise, this experience puts you in control of your own boat, guided safely through the legendary harbor of Old San Juan. Designed for travelers who want freedom without risk, this guided mini boat experience blends the thrill of self-driving with expert navigation, making it one of the most unique San Juan boat tours available today. From historic forts to colorful waterfront neighborhoods, this is hands-down one of the most memorable ways to explore San Juan from the water. blurb: i Tour Puerto Rico offers tours and activities by land, sea, and nature across Puerto Rico. Guests can choose from ATV adventures, zipline tours, horseback riding, catamaran and boat tours, kayaking, snorkeling, and sightseeing tours. The company specializes in experiences for adventure seekers, families, couples, and groups.
